entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
----- 
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANANT BIJAY SINGH -----
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Santosh Kumar, Advocate  For the State : A.P.P  -----
 06/Dated: 29/06/2018 The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Narayanpur P.S. Case No. 41/2017,
corresponding to G.R. No. 798/2017, the case registered under Sections 429,406,188,120B of the Indian Penal Code, section 11(a),(d),(e),(I),(k) of Prevention of Cruelty to Animals act, 1960, Rules 3 of of Prevention to animal ( slaughter house) Rules, 2001 and u/s 55 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals act, 1960
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties.
In view of nature of allegation as alleged against the petitioner in the FIR, I am not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, anticipatory bail application of the is, hereby, rejected.

( Anant Bijay Singh, J.) Raman/
